THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 33

I, N.A.A.S. Nissankaarachchi, the Divisional Secretary, Dompe of Gampaha District in Western Province, hereby give notice, under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act that the statutory compensation payable has been deposited in the District Court of Pugoda against the Case Numbers mentioned in the schedule below to be drawn by the persons entitled to the statutory compensation in terms of the Land Acquisition Act, as a failure of succession to the lands acquired by the State described in the schedule below has been reported.
N. A. A. S. Nissankaarachchi, Divisional Secretary, Dompe.
